title: papaver dahlianum subsp. polare
intro: Papaver dahlianum subsp. polare, commonly known as Arctic poppy, is a flowering plant that belongs to the poppy family and is native to the Arctic regions of the world. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Papaver dahlianum subsp. polare include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
